text:
Olivia: Quick check: adding a tiny 'peer feedback' cheat sheet to the self-review guidance. Idea: 3 short prompts peers can paste (strength, suggestion, example). This should reduce the freeform essays we get.

Ben: Love it. Can you share the actual prompts?

Olivia: Sure, here they are:
1) Strength: One line - what did this person do well?
2) Suggestion: One-line, specific next step (focus on behavior, not trait).
3) Example: One concrete incident or link (PR, convo) that supports the note.

Hayden: Can we add suggested length limits? Like max 40 words each. Keeps things scannable.

Olivia: Added. Also adding an example peer snippet:
Strength: Strong at breaking down ambiguous specs into actionable tasks.
Suggestion: Call out unclear assumptions in async threads earlier (one sentence).
Example: In RFC #45, added a checklist and timeline which sped up the design review.

People Ops Bot: Reminder: Peer feedback collection opens 2024-06-20.

Ben: Looks great. Can we bundle this into the kickoff email as an optional copy-paste block? Managers will like that.
